integrity: Proof for every positive integer parameter is provided in RESULT.md. Two finite verifiers and captured outputs are included; computations supplement rather than replace the infinite proof. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns complete split graphs, not all split graphs; fixed and initially two-periodic states and a sharp uniform entrance-time bound are classified, not all transient basin populations. Historical priority cannot be proven by literature searching and remains subject to unindexed work.
title: Exact majority-periodic states and a sharp three-update bound on complete split graphs
